sections.Profile:
The "Globe Trotter" pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in November 1951, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Wayne Neyens, with artwork by Roy Parker. The machine features four flippers, four pop bumpers, two rollunder lanes, and a kick-out hole.
